title: Missouri appeals court voids $1 million in punitive damages against therapist in affair case
summary_full: In a significant ruling, the Missouri Court of Appeals reinforced a jury's verdict against therapist Craig Politte for professional misconduct, confirming charges of medical negligence, battery, and breaches of the Missouri Merchandising Practices Act. Although the jury's compensation award exceeds $2 million, punitive damages were annulled due to distinctions concerning negligence per se claims.
